narrative.intro: JT4 has $376M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. JT4 received 1 award this fiscal year, and the average award size is $376M. Obligations fell 5.6% year over year. The multi-year record shows FY21 at $322M, FY22 at $325M, FY23 at $391M, FY24 at $385M, FY25 at $398M, and FY26 at $376M. FY25 recorded $398M, the largest annual obligation in the available series. The current-year total is partial because the period is fiscal year to date. The page is labeled JT4: Federal Contracts, Agencies & Awards and the report type is vendor, which frames the figures as contract obligations except where award values are noted separately.

sections.heading: How has JT4's federal business trended year over year?
sections.body: JT4's obligations rose from $322M in FY21 to $398M in FY25 before falling to $376M in FY26. Obligations fell 5.6% year over year. The series shows growth through FY25, with FY25 at $398M as the high point, and a partial-year total of $376M for FY26. The FY26 total is fiscal year to date.

sections.heading: How concentrated are JT4's awards?
